layman_headline: Market fear is high and the swing trade candidates are too risky — staying on the sidelines for now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a state of fear (27/100), which has been worsening over the past week. Bitcoin is holding relatively steady at $64,569, but altcoins are getting crushed — Bitcoin dominance is at 56.6%, meaning money is flowing out of smaller coins and into Bitcoin. The swing trade candidates available right now are mostly low-quality: some have already run up too much (BTW +49% in a week), others lack critical technical data (no RSI, no chart analysis), and the ones with data show conflicting signals. This is not a good environment to chase altcoin trades.
layman_action: Do nothing right now. Wait for the Fear & Greed Index to either stabilize above 30 (confirming recovery) or drop below 20 (potential capitulation bounce). Keep cash ready for a better setup.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven candidates systematically. UB shows a bullish chart structure (Three White Soldiers, above two MAs) but the 29.9% daily drop is a massive red flag that invalidates the pattern — this looks like a pump-and-dump unwind. KAITO's RSI at 65 with a bearish marubozu despite being down 28% weekly suggests distribution, not accumulation. BTW is up 49% in a week with zero technical data — classic overextension. LDO has no chart data despite being a known DeFi protocol (Lido DAO). MON, KITE, and USDG lack sufficient data for any meaningful analysis. With Fear & Greed at 27 (per Rule 3, short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous at these levels), BTC dominance at 56.6% suppressing alts, and no strong risk/reward setup exceeding 2x, the correct call is to preserve capital and wait.
